{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('[^0-9.]', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Handle sentinel values in customer_age: replace -1 with NaN
sales_df['customer_age_clean'] = sales_df['customer_age'].where(sales_df['customer_age'] != -1, None)

# Confirm the fix
print('After cleaning, `customer_age_clean` has NaN for -1:', sales_df['customer_age_clean'].isna().sum())
print('Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1):')
mean_age_converted = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]['customer_age_clean'].mean()
print(mean_age_converted)"}
